clues.it: Paolo era accanto a una poltrona di velluto.
clues.en: Paolo was beside a velvet armchair.

clues.it: Irene era da sola nelle Cucine dell'Hotel.
clues.en: Irene was alone in the Hotel Kitchens.

clues.it: Luca era l'unica persona su un cappotto caduto.
clues.en: Luca was the only person on a dropped coat.

clues.it: Fabio era accanto a un tavolo da biliardo.
clues.en: Fabio was beside a billiard table.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Marta era accanto a un baule da viaggio.
clues.en: Marta was beside a steamer trunk.

steps.it: L'indizio di Luca lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Luca's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 6th.

steps.it: Anna può stare solo nella 2ª riga: escludendola, a Paolo resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Anna can only be in the 2nd row: ruling it out leaves Paolo a single square: row 1st, column 2nd.
